title: Confirm frontend boundary
intro: I inspected both repositories. Bencho is copyable React source, so the work applies mainly to maros-next; maros-nest is included only if an accepted new capability needs API behavior or persistence.
coverage: 6/10 clear; route boundary needs owner confirmation

questions.text: Should the full frontend boundary include interactive public/external routes (public project or estimate links, contact and invitation flows) as well as authenticated CRM routes?

options.label: Authenticated routes plus public project links

questions.why: You asked for every place that needs interaction; including external-facing workflows gives the audit the same product-wide boundary while backend work remains conditional.

q1.note: This follows the original instruction to cover every interactive part of Maros, including external-facing routes.
